truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 fully identified 14 of the 20 supplied true vulnerabilities, partially identified 2, and missed 4. Several previous findings had severity or CWE corrections. Some previous findings were not supplied truth items and are not credited here.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Format string vulnerability in debug logging
Items.Notes: Run 2 explicitly identified the runtime log format printf issue and tied it to log_format; only severity was lower than the supplied truth.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Signed integer overflow in factorial implementation
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the factorial signed integer overflow in the result *= i loop; severity was lower than the supplied truth.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Use-after-free of history scratch buffer during cleanup
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the scratch buffer being used by thread-pool tasks after memory pool cleanup; severity was lower than the supplied truth.
Run 2 identified validator_path/config_file concatenation passed to system(); severity was lower than the supplied truth.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Stack buffer overflow from inverted length check in evaluate_expression
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the inverted-length strcpy(input_buffer_) overflow and separately identified the safe_string_copy off-by-one, covering the supplied anchors; the first finding overclaimed severity and used a generic CWE.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Data race and lost updates in ThreadSafeCounter
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the read-before-lock increment and unsynchronized get(); severity was lower than the supplied truth.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Authentication bypass via EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE after five attempts
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the login_attempts_ > 5 and EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE authentication path; supplied truth classifies it as a High logic-bomb issue rather than Critical authentication bypass.
Run 2 identified config_dir_ + filename traversal in load_config.
Run 2 identified the 256-byte heap buffer and unbounded strcpy(expression_buffer_); severity was lower and CWE was more generic than supplied truth.
Run 2 identified the hardcoded ADMIN_SECRET value.

Run 2 identified the weak mt19937/uniform_int_distribution token generation, but downgraded it to Informational/CWE-330 and hedged that the token was not shown to be used for access control; supplied truth treats it as High/CWE-338.
Run 2 did not identify the static std::tm cached_time/localtime race in log_debug_message.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: OS command injection via environment variable in emergency audit logging
Items.Notes: Run 2 flagged the same environment-controlled emergency log path and system() call, but framed it as command injection rather than identifying the supplied insecure temporary file handling issue.
Run 2 did not identify persistent authentication state or CWE-613; it found related auth bypass and token generation but not the persistence issue.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Uncaught std::stod exception in variable command
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the uncaught std::stod(tokens[3]) in handle_variable_command; supplied truth uses CWE-754 rather than CWE-20.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Integer underflow in MemoryPool::allocate split logic
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES underflow; severity was lower than supplied truth.
Run 2 did not identify unbounded recursion in parse_expression/parse_factor around PAREN_OPEN.
Run 2 identified unsynchronized result_cache_ access and correctly noted cache_mutex_ was not used.
Run 2's path-traversal finding touched the same code region but did not identify the TOCTOU race between filesystem::exists, sleep_for, and ifstream; it cannot be credited as found.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Integer division by zero in calculate_route_score
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the token_length division by zero; severity was higher than supplied truth.
